reference.identifierEncoding: Original synthesized DTMF; no spoken digits or voice files

waveformVerification.method: Numeric analysis of the production PCM renderer used by RadioClient.probe, not an independent test waveform generator

designAdjustments: radio_countercode uses original DTMF tones plus written digits instead of spoken digits.
The common calibration adds a distinct four-digit identification section before the main three-pulse sequence.
The 3/4 pulse count refers to the main sequence, not the identification tones.
Countercode and order-swap alter the synthetic calibration; they do not rewrite human speech.
Channel and reverberation readings describe the generated signal, not measured headphones or room acoustics.
limitations: Browser audio and RTC APIs are simulated in lifecycle and graph tests; numeric PCM checks use the real production waveform code.
No physical microphone, loudspeaker, headset, human listening or real browser audio rendering was validated by this run.
No new connected WebRTC session, deployed TURN relay or cross-network voice transport was validated.
The previous two-tab test with zero ICE candidates remains historical evidence and is not upgraded by these PCM tests.
UI integration, distribution builds and publishing are separate checks performed by the parent task.
